author: Wanda Wilson Dooley
text: Did she wipe it with alcohol and let it air dry? Also, it requires a fair bit of pressure for it to stick when you use the applicator so it is actually pretty common for them to fall off if somebody else uses the applicator instead of you pressing on it yourself.

author: Ronald Murchison
text: That's why some of us use alternate body parts. I use my belly. Never has fallen off and can't get knocked off.
